
{{alias}}( options )
    Returns a quantitative scale instance.

    Parameters
    ----------
    options: Object
        Options.

    options.bins: ArrayLikeObject|Object|Signal (optional)
        Bin boundaries over the scale domain.

    options.clamp: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether to clamp output values to the scale range.
        Default: false.

    options.domain: ArrayLikeObject|Object|Signal (optional)
        Domain of associated data values.

    options.domainMax: number (optional)
        Maximum value in the scale domain (overrides the `domain` option).

    options.domainMin: number (optional)
        Minimum value in the scale domain (overrides the `domain` option).

    options.domainMid: number (optional)
        Single mid-point value inserted into a two-element domain.

    options.domainRaw: ArrayLikeObject (optional)
        Array of raw domain values which overrides the `domain` property.

    options.interpolate: string|Object (optional)
        Scale range interpolation method.

    options.name: string
        Scale name.

    options.nice: boolean|number|Signal (optional)
        Scale domain "nicing". Default: false.

    options.padding: number (optional)
        Scale domain padding (in pixels).

    options.range: ArrayLikeObject|Object|Signal|string (optional)
        Scale range.

    options.reverse: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether to reverse the order of the scale range.
        Default: false.

    options.round: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether to round numeric output values to integers.
        Default: false.

    options.type: string (optional)
        Scale type. Default: 'linear'.

    options.zero: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether the scale domain should include zero.

    Returns
    -------
    scale: QuantitativeScale
        Quantitative scale instance.

    scale.bins
        Bins boundaries of the scale domain.

    scale.clamp
        Boolean indicating whether to clamp output values to the scale range.

    scale.domain
        Scale domain.

    scale.domainMax
        Explicit scale domain maximum value.

    scale.domainMid
        Mid-point inserted into a two-element scale domain.

    scale.domainMin
        Explicit scale domain minimum value.

    scale.domainRaw
        Raw scale domain values.

    scale.interpolate
        Scale range interpolation method.

    scale.name
        Scale name.

    scale.nice
        Scale domain "nicing".

    scale.padding
        Scale domain padding (in pixels).

    scale.properties
        List of enumerable properties.

    scale.range
        Scale range.

    scale.reverse
        Boolean indicating whether to reverse the order of the scale range.

    scale.round
        Boolean indicating whether to round numeric output value to integers.

    scale.type
        Scale type.

    scale.zero
        Boolean indicating whether the scale domain should include zero.

    scale.toJSON()
        Serializes a quantitative scale instance to a JSON object.

    Examples
    --------
    > var scale = new {{alias}}( { 'name': 'xScale' } )
    <QuantitativeScale>
    > scale.name
    'xScale'

    // Set a property:
    > scale.type = 'log';
    > scale.type
    'log'

    // Serialize to JSON:
    > scale.toJSON()
    {...}

    --------
